name: nethack-chat
description: Middleware that exposes NetHack as a language-controllable environment for humans and LLM agents.

scripts.bootstrap: npm run runtime:fetch && npm run runtime:build && npm run runtime:verify && npm run typecheck
scripts.eval:fake: npm run typecheck && node eval/dist-harness/harness.mjs && node eval/dist-harness/acceptance.mjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && node --test eval/dist-harness/real-adapter-contract.mjs && node eval/runtime-fetch.mjs
scripts.eval:real: npm run typecheck && npm run runtime:verify && node eval/real-browser.mjs
